verified_facts: composite combines Time Stamped archive and National LIDAR Programme
newest best-resolution repeat survey is used
composite survey period spans 6 June 2000 to 2 April 2022
metadata index identifies contributing survey by location
individual contributing surveys have +/-15cm vertical RMSE specification
10m DTM is resampled from 2m DTM using bilinear interpolation
1m 2m and 10m samples are not independent elevation evidence
quality_effect: Prevents multi-resolution EA samples derived from the same lineage from being counted as independent confirmations or gaining artificial precision.
